thread:
alex: Quick nudge — PR #11984 is ready for merge but linux-integration CI is stuck in the queue. Trying to avoid landing during the Friday deploy freeze. PR: https://git.internal/r/11984

ci-bot: Build queued on linux-integration (pool). Current queue position: 24. Estimated wait ~45m.

maya: @alex I can take a quick pass. which tests are failing?

alex: Mostly one flaky e2e: checkout-service::checkout_flow_timeout. Here's the failing trace:

```
ERROR checkout_flow_timeout
  at /srv/app/tests/e2e/checkout.test.js:142
  TimeoutError: expected response within 30s
  --- async stack ---
```

oliver: Heads-up from release side — deploy freeze starts Fri 00:00 UTC. If CI doesn't clear, we should avoid landing and schedule a Monday canary.

sam: I'll try to review now. If it looks fine I'll mark approved but add a hold label so it doesn't auto-merge. :thumbsup:

maya: left a small comment on flake mitigation (reduce timeout + explicit retry). If you push that, I can re-approve.

alex: pushed a quick revert of flaky assertion (sha: abc123). Can someone trigger a rerun for linux-integration? cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex for sha abc123. New queue position: 3. ETA ~7m.

sre-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze starts Fri 00:00 UTC. Any merges after that will be queued and may not deploy until the freeze ends. If you can't get green before freeze, plan for a post-freeze canary and include rollback instructions.

oliver: If rerun fails, plan B: keep PR open, schedule a Monday morning canary, and add a rollback note to the PR description. Will coordinate with platform for priority slot.

alex: will add rollback note and a short changelog entry to the PR description now. Thanks for the quick help everyone :pray:

sam: Approved pending green CI and rollback note.

alex: Thanks — monitoring the rerun, will update thread with outcome.
